youtube_title: Jesus... Everyone Went Home For The Holidays Except Me | Psalm 25:16 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left.

Everyone went home for the holidays. He stayed back in an empty hostel, ate biscuits for dinner, and told his mom he was fine.

Him: Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left.

Him: The mess is closed. I ate biscuits for dinner and told my mom I had a proper meal.

Jesus: You said that so she wouldn't worry. That's love, even when it's lonely.

Him: Ten days of an empty corridor. Nobody would even notice if I didn't come out of my room.

Jesus: I would notice. I'm in that corridor with you. You're not as unseen as it feels right now.

Him: Then why is my phone so quiet? Not one message all day.

Jesus: Because they all think you're fine. You don't have to keep pretending. Send one honest text today. Just tell someone you're still here.

"Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted."
Psalms 25:16 (NIV)

Jesus: That prayer is in the Bible. You're allowed to pray it too, out loud, in that empty room.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
